Another exciting SOUNDIT Club night awaits 🖤

@dmx_krew arrives with his live set of instrumental electro, synth-pop and analog techno. The project of UK producer Ed DMX, founder of Breakin’ and Fresh Up Records and a veteran of labels such as Rephlex and International Deejay Gigolo Records, has been exploring the sounds of vintage hardware since the mid-nineties.

The night also features Berlin-based Spanish producer @pearl_fallingethics, founder of Falling Ethics Records and part of the PoleGroup roster. His raw techno sound is shaped by a careful balance of tension and release.

Also on the bill is our longtime resident @djfrasoler, a pillar of Barcelona’s electronic music scene, bringing his encyclopedic knowledge of techno, electro and house to one of his trademark hypnotic, eclectic selections.

Joining him is @_tauceti_, part of a new generation of techno artists. Her sound combines percussive rhythms with dark, atmospheric textures, while her productions move between ambient and techno.
